title: Subject Test: Operating Systems
description: Process management, CPU scheduling, virtual memory paging, Banker’s algorithm, and file systems.

title: Subject Test: Databases (DBMS)
description: Functional dependencies, normal forms (BCNF/3NF), transactions, B+ trees, and SQL queries.

title: Subject Test: Computer Networks
description: TCP congestion control, IP fragmentation, CIDR subnetting, CSMA/CD, and routing protocols.

title: Subject Test: Computer Organization & Architecture
description: Cache memory tag calculations, pipelining hazards, speedup, memory interleaving, and addressing modes.

title: Subject Test: Algorithms
description: Asymptotic recurrences, dynamic programming, Huffman coding, Floyd-Warshall, and graph DFS.

title: Subject Test: Theory of Computation
description: DFA state minimization, pumping lemma, CNF derivations, DCFLs, and Turing machine decidability.

title: Subject Test: Compiler Design
description: Lexical analysis, LL(1) parsing, LR(0) canonical items, SLR(1) conflicts, and basic blocks.

title: Subject Test: Digital Logic
description: K-maps, combinational circuits, ripple carry adders, synchronous counters, and flip-flops.

title: Subject Test: Programming & Data Structures
description: C pointers, BST traversals, AVL trees, binary min-heaps, and circular queues.

title: Subject Test: Engineering Mathematics
description: Linear algebra, Bayes theorem, maxima-minima calculus, posets/lattices, and derangements.

title: Subject Test: General Aptitude
description: Verbal ability, quantitative reasoning, spatial visualization, and analytical logic.

title: Topic Test: CPU Scheduling & Synchronization
description: SJF turnaround, Round Robin, critical section progress, and Banker’s safety algorithm.

title: Topic Test: Paging, Virtual Memory & TLBs
description: Multi-level page tables, TLB hit rates, and Belady’s anomaly.

title: Topic Test: B/B+ Trees & Transactions
description: B+ tree node splits, index capacity, 2-phase locking, and conflict serializability.

title: Topic Test: TCP Congestion & IPv4 Subnetting
description: TCP window growth, slow start thresholds, CIDR host allocations, and longest prefix matching.

title: Topic Test: Cache Tag Mapping & Pipelining
description: Set-associative cache tags, hit penalties, pipeline data forwarding, and stalls.

title: Topic Test: Dynamic Programming & Graphs
description: Floyd-Warshall all-pairs shortest paths, Huffman coding, and topological sort DFS.

title: Topic Test: Regular Languages, DFA & Decidability
description: DFA state minimization, Chomsky normal form, and Halting problem undecidability.

title: Topic Test: LR Parsing & Syntax-Directed Definitions
description: Canonical LR(0) state machines, shift-reduce conflicts, and S-attributed vs L-attributed grammars.

title: Topic Test: Linear Algebra & Probability
description: Matrix eigenvalues, Bayes theorem, global extrema calculus, and derangements.
